visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female guard in a khaki military-style uniform stands at the entrance of a school with a black iron gate and red brick buildings. A male student with bright orange hair and a school uniform approaches her. The lighting is bright natural daylight, and the camera is set at a static eye-level medium shot. (2) The female guard gestures for the student's backpack. He swings a black bag off his shoulder and hands it over with a frustrated facial expression. The scene transitions with a jump cut to the student jumping over an area to enter, but the guard is already watching him. (3) The student is seen again walking with two other students, one with bleached blonde hair and one female student. The guard intercepts them at the gate. The students exhibit sheepish or playful behavior while the guard maintains a stern, authoritative posture with her hands on her hips. (4) Close-up shots capture the exaggerated facial reactions of the male students, showing wide eyes and nervous smiles. The background remains consistent with the school entrance architecture. (5) The guard inspects the bags and points towards the school interior, commanding the students to move. The editing pace is fast, utilizing quick cuts to move between different confrontation scenarios at the gate.
